title: Dizzy's Just Essentials
description: Essential mods for creating your own modpack. Free to edit and republish as you please.
body:
Bare Bones Essentials Modpack designed to get you started on building your own modpack. You are free to edit and republish the modpack however you like, I won't even ask for credit.

Optimization is already mostly taken care of, with the use of [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Not Enough Recipe Book](https://modrinth.com/mod/notenoughrecipebook), and [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium). Quality of Life Essentials? Got you with [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks), and [Inventory Essentials](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-essentials). 

Whether you just want an optimized vanilla minecraft with some needed QOL, or to build your own modpack, maybe you want to restart your modpack and don't feel like finding all your essentials again, this is for you.
